Patch release: the download speed graph gets its full height back, toolbar buttons stay intact after JD rebuilds its toolbar, and fresh installs can no longer come up with a white (light) GUI.

## Fixed
- **Speed graph clipped to half height.** JD's content pane grants the `dock NORTH` toolbar a strip measured before the agent grows the graph row, so the lower half of the 64px graph and of the buttons laid out for it was simply cut off. The agent now also pins the toolbar height in the content pane's component constraint (`height <pref>!`) and revalidates from the window. Verified in CI with real pixel geometry (toolbar 1024x68, graph 300x64) and on the box.
- **Toolbar row reverting after rebuilds.** JD's `updateToolbar()` installs a fresh MigLayout with the stock 32px row on every rebuild, which the old one-shot guard never re-grew. The row is now grown once per layout instance, and the hidden native speed meter is re-excluded from the layout (`hidemode 3`) after every rebuild so it can no longer reserve up to 300px of invisible width.
- **White GUI on fresh installs (forum report).** Two timing-dependent root causes, both fixed:
  - `UIManager.setLookAndFeel(String)` resolves the LAF class through the **system classloader**, but JD's launcher wires `flatlaf.jar` only into its own classloader. Depending on boot timing the first GUI start failed with `ClassNotFoundException: com.formdev.flatlaf.FlatDarkLaf` and fell back to the light default. The agent now appends `flatlaf.jar` to the system classloader through the official `Instrumentation.appendToSystemClassLoaderSearch` API.
  - The headless pre-install could be stopped while the updater was still writing `flatlaf.jar`, leaving a truncated jar that satisfied every "is it installed?" check and permanently blocked the theme. The pre-install settle gate now requires a zip-valid `flatlaf.jar` before the chain is stopped, a boot heal removes a corrupt jar, deregisters the extension and re-requests it, and the `JD_SELFUPDATE` freeze gate validates the jar instead of only checking that it exists.

  Existing broken installs repair themselves on the next container start; a Force Update is all that is needed.

## Added
- **Opt-in geometry diagnostics.** Set `JD_DEBUG_GEO=1` to log the real pixel geometry around the speed graph (window, menubar, toolbar bounds, layout constraints, native and replacement graph) every ~5 seconds to the container log.
- **CI geometry probe.** A manually triggered workflow boots the built image, collects the geometry log lines, FlatLaf install forensics and a PNG screenshot of the live desktop as artifacts.

## Changed
- The v3 preview channel (`feat/v3` -> `:v3-preview`) is retired now that v3 is released; if you tested the preview, switch the container back to `:latest`.
